item: the test process binds the engine to the suite's directory before any test body, and a test that binds it elsewhere fails by name
summary: tests/test_country_migration.py::test_the_diagnostics_card... failed in a selection after tests/test_init_steps.py (alpha2 for alpha3): src.database.session binds its engine to OO_DATA_DIR at its first import, the settings store reads the variable on every call, and a dd-fixture test moved the variable before importing the session. tests/conftest.py now imports the session right after its env defaults, so a selection binds like a full run (42 of 220 files that mention OO_DATA_DIR bound the engine to their own tmp_path when run alone); the dd fixture imports first; an autouse net fails the test that makes the first binding anywhere but the suite's directory, at its own teardown. Cost +0.21 s per pytest process (median of 10), nothing in a full run. Red-without run: a child pytest passes the bad order with the real conftest and fails it by name with a copy that lost the import line.
